sentinel-payg-high-volume-commitment-tie.title: A commitment tier is likely cheaper than pay-as-you-go at this volume
sentinel-payg-high-volume-commitment-tie.body: This estimate prices 35 GB/day or more of analytics logs at pay-as-you-go. Sentinel commitment tiers (a fixed daily amount, with overage billed at the same effective rate) are priced below pay-as-you-go from about 34 GB/day (the 50 GB/day tier), so compare them before committing to the pay-as-you-go rate; set commitment to cheapest to see the lowest option.
